about: Sakiko's three app.js additions, and ONLY those: the FxSystem ctx gains `rangedOf` (so a ranged kit that draws its own attack visual skips the melee slash) and `units` (the by-position owner lookup notes.js needs), and the battle frame calls fx.syncNotes(). Everything else in her app.js is her older baseline and must NOT be taken — dust 0.2.5's own app.js work (AbortSignal cancellation, officialDamageNumbers, zoom/pan, board3d packs, syncView, refreshDownLabels) stays exactly as it is.

hunks.find:
subProfOf: (defId, info = null) => ((info && info.standInFor && data.standIn(defId)) || (info && info.diy && data.diy(defId, info.diy)) || data.chess(defId))?.subProfessionId || null,
    view: (id) => views.get(id) || null,
